mentions.name: Lexplain
mentions.description: AI-powered service that explains Linux kernel commits and release notes, letting engineers scan kernel changes quickly — covering what the code actually does, why it matters, and what it means for real production systems. Provides 7,000+ commit analyses and release notes for the 7.0-rc series, with 7.0 stable release notes in progress.
mentions.problem: Keeping up with kernel changes is hard for engineers who aren't kernel developers, and unexpected kernel behavior silently impacting production systems happens more often than it should.
mentions.audience: Most engineers running Linux in production aren't kernel developers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building Lexplain (https://lexplain.net/release-notes), an AI-powered service that explains Linux kernel commits and release notes.
